journeyTemplate.blurb: Meet me this week and record your interview. Those two get everything else moving.

milestones.detail: About an hour, to go through this whole list together. Pick any time this week that suits you.
milestones.notePrompt: Anything you want to cover when we meet? (optional)
steps: Pick a time on the booking page below. You get a calendar invite straight away.
Bring anything you already have: your ABN, your Working With Children Check, your insurance.
milestones.title: Book a time with me this week

milestones.detail: About 45 minutes. I ask, you talk, and I record it. Your story, your tools, what parents ask you. Talk the way you'd talk to a parent. Stories are gold. Skip any question you don't want to answer. The questions are below, so you can think ahead. Your words become the website, the ads and the posts. I tick this once we've done it.
milestones.notePrompt: Or paste a link to your recording
steps: YOU AND WHY. 1. What happened in your own life that led you to counselling? 2. When did you first think, "kids this little need this"? Tell me about that moment. 3. What does ROR (Raw, Open, Ready) mean to you? 4. What do you wish you'd known when your boys were 4 to 6?

THE PARENTS YOU'RE FOR. 5. Describe the parent who walks in your door. What's their week like? 6. What do parents say to you when they're at the end of their rope? Their actual words. 7. What have they usually tried already that hasn't worked? 8. What are parents scared of, or embarrassed about, when it comes to their child's big feelings? 9. What do they want to feel by the end of a term?

THE KIDS. 10. Tell me about a "spicy" child, a "sparkly" child, an "energy bunny" and a quiet one. How does each one show big feelings? 11. What does a shy child need on their first day? 12. What's a moment with a child you'll never forget? (No names.)

THE TOOLS AND THE CLASS. 13. Walk me through a class, from the moment they arrive to the moment they leave. 14. Pick 3 tools. For each one: what's it called, what's it for, and how would you explain it to a 4-year-old? 15. Why play, clay and paint, and not sitting down and talking? 16. Why two weeks per tool? Why a term at a time? 17. What goes in the take-home guide? What should a parent do with it?

TRUST AND THE HARD QUESTIONS. 18. How is this different from therapy? When would you send a family somewhere else? 19. What would you say to a parent who thinks their child is "too much" for a group? 20. What can a parent honestly expect after one term? What won't change? 21. How do you keep kids safe and the room calm with 10 little ones?

QUICK-FIRE. 22. Finish this: "Tiny ROR is for the parent who…" 23. Finish this: "Let them ror means…" 24. One thing a parent could try tonight with a big feeling. How would you teach it in 30 seconds? 25. Anything I haven't asked that parents should know?
milestones.title: Our recorded chat

uploadOptions.hint: Upload it here. Files up to 25MB. A longer recording: put it in Google Drive or Dropbox and paste the link below.

journeyTemplate.blurb: Your website, your web address, your pages and the accounts for payments and ads. You own every one of them. You add me as a helper. Never send me a password.

milestones.detail: So I can see your current website and move the best of it across. You invite me from inside Wix. I never need your login.
milestones.important: Never send me a password, a key or a bank login. Not here, not on WhatsApp. You set this up yourself and keep the logins to yourself.
steps: Log in to Wix and open your site's dashboard.
Go to Settings, then Roles & Permissions.
Press Invite People, and type jesse@allconvos.ai.
Choose the Admin role, then send the invite.
milestones.title: Add me to your Wix site

milestones.detail: Your web address is looked after at Porkbun. A few settings there need to change so it points at the new site. We do it together on a call: you log in, I tell you what to click. It takes about ten minutes.
milestones.important: Never send me a password, a key or a bank login. Not here, not on WhatsApp. You set this up yourself and keep the logins to yourself.
milestones.notePrompt: Which web addresses do you own? (optional)
milestones.title: Your web address at Porkbun

milestones.detail: I suggest tinyror.com.au. A .com.au needs your ABN. We'll buy it together when we meet, in your name.
milestones.notePrompt: Another name you'd prefer? (optional)
milestones.title: Your Tiny ROR web address

milestones.detail: A fresh Tiny ROR Instagram, just for families from Byron Bay to Ballina, and a Facebook page. We open them together, about ten minutes. Then paste the links here. If you're happy for me to reuse posts from your ROR The Journey pages, paste those links too.
milestones.notePrompt: Your Instagram and Facebook links
milestones.title: Instagram and Facebook pages

milestones.detail: Meta is the company behind Facebook and Instagram. One partner request lets me post, and make and run your ads, from my own login. It covers your Facebook page, your Instagram and your ad account. The ads run in your account, on your card, and you approve each one.
milestones.important: Never send me a password, a key or a bank login. Not here, not on WhatsApp. You set this up yourself and keep the logins to yourself.
milestones.notePrompt: Your Business ID, once you have it (optional)
steps: First, turn on two-step login for your own Facebook account (Settings, then Password and security).
Go to business.facebook.com. If you don't have a business account yet, create one in the business name.
Open Settings, then Partners. Press Add, then "Give a partner access to your assets".
Type my Business ID. I'll message it to you.
Tick your Facebook page, your Instagram account and your ad account, with full control, then save.
Add your own card to the ad account (Billing). Nothing is spent until you say go.
milestones.title: Add me as a partner on Meta

milestones.important: Never send me a password, a key or a bank login. Not here, not on WhatsApp. You set this up yourself and keep the logins to yourself.

Type jesse@allconvos.ai, choose Manager, and send the invite.
milestones.title: Add me to your Google listing

none@day1.name: The offer

none@day1.blurb: Your website, your web address, your pages and the accounts for payments and ads. You own every one of them. You add me as a helper. Never send me a password.

milestones.detail: So I can see your current website and move the best of it across. You invite me from inside Wix. I never need your login.
milestones.important: Never send me a password, a key or a bank login. Not here, not on WhatsApp. You set this up yourself and keep the logins to yourself.
steps: Log in to Wix and open your site's dashboard.
Go to Settings, then Roles & Permissions.
Press Invite People, and type jesse@allconvos.ai.
Choose the Admin role, then send the invite.
milestones.title: Add me to your Wix site

milestones.detail: Your web address is looked after at Porkbun. A few settings there need to change so it points at the new site. We do it together on a call: you log in, I tell you what to click. It takes about ten minutes.
milestones.important: Never send me a password, a key or a bank login. Not here, not on WhatsApp. You set this up yourself and keep the logins to yourself.
milestones.notePrompt: Which web addresses do you own? (optional)
milestones.title: Your web address at Porkbun

milestones.detail: I suggest tinyror.com.au. A .com.au needs your ABN. We'll buy it together when we meet, in your name.
milestones.notePrompt: Another name you'd prefer? (optional)
milestones.title: Your Tiny ROR web address

milestones.detail: A fresh Tiny ROR Instagram, just for families from Byron Bay to Ballina, and a Facebook page. We open them together, about ten minutes. Then paste the links here. If you're happy for me to reuse posts from your ROR The Journey pages, paste those links too.
milestones.notePrompt: Your Instagram and Facebook links
milestones.title: Instagram and Facebook pages

milestones.detail: Meta is the company behind Facebook and Instagram. One partner request lets me post, and make and run your ads, from my own login. It covers your Facebook page, your Instagram and your ad account. The ads run in your account, on your card, and you approve each one.
milestones.important: Never send me a password, a key or a bank login. Not here, not on WhatsApp. You set this up yourself and keep the logins to yourself.
milestones.notePrompt: Your Business ID, once you have it (optional)
steps: First, turn on two-step login for your own Facebook account (Settings, then Password and security).
Go to business.facebook.com. If you don't have a business account yet, create one in the business name.
Open Settings, then Partners. Press Add, then "Give a partner access to your assets".
Type my Business ID. I'll message it to you.
Tick your Facebook page, your Instagram account and your ad account, with full control, then save.
Add your own card to the ad account (Billing). Nothing is spent until you say go.
milestones.title: Add me as a partner on Meta

milestones.detail: Your Google Business Profile is how you show on the map in Ballina. It's free. Add me as a manager, so I can check it and fill it in. If you don't have a listing yet, tell me in the box and we'll make one together.
milestones.important: Never send me a password, a key or a bank login. Not here, not on WhatsApp. You set this up yourself and keep the logins to yourself.
milestones.notePrompt: No listing yet, or not sure? Tell me here (optional)
steps: Signed in to Google, search for your business name.
On your listing, press the three dots, then Business Profile settings.
Choose People and access, then Add.
Type jesse@allconvos.ai, choose Manager, and send the invite.
milestones.title: Add me to your Google listing

milestones.detail: Stripe takes the parents' payments and pays them straight into your bank account. Set it up yourself at stripe.com, in the business name. Later you connect it to the booking page yourself, with me on a call.
milestones.important: Never send me a password, a key or a bank login. Not here, not on WhatsApp. You set this up yourself and keep the logins to yourself.
